aggregation.cell_metric: equal-weight arithmetic mean across the five predeclared folds
aggregation.survival_scale_rule: aggregate fold-level c-index values; never pool raw risks across independently trained folds

agentic_lift.contrast: frozen autoMIL winner minus native baseline within the same cell

titan_lift.contrast: frozen TITAN-lineage winner minus native TITAN baseline
titan_lift.restriction: reported separately; never ranked against tile-feature arms

inference.multiplicity_adjustment: not applicable because no null-hypothesis tests are declared
inference.scope: descriptive inference over the complete frozen 130-cell census
inference.warning: shared patients, cohorts, encoders, tasks, and one seed prohibit treating 130 cells or five folds as independent samples

missingness.policy: fail closed; do not emit a publication report from an incomplete or inconsistent campaign

ranking.top_arm_definition: the complete set tied at the maximum primary metric
